title: RadialHotbarMOVE
description: A console-style radial item wheel inspired by Animal Crossing and GTA V to redefine your inventory navigation.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47473410b6f927310a2dcda773e0b5c524cfeb8e.png)

**RadialHotbarMOVE** transforms the classic linear Minecraft hotbar into a fluid, circular selection wheel.

Inspired by the polished UI of Animal Crossing: New Horizons and the quick-access weapon wheel of Grand Theft Auto V, this mod is designed for players who want a more immersive and modern way to swap items.


## Quick Select System 🎡
Hold TAB to bring up the radial wheel. Simply move your mouse or use the scroll wheel to highlight a slot, then release to equip.
- Zero Mouse Clicks: Everything is handled by movement and key release.
- Vertical Sensitivity: Move your mouse up or down to cycle through items instantly.

## Dynamic Interface 🖥️
To keep your screen clean and cinematic:
- Auto-Hide Hotbar: The vanilla hotbar is hidden by default but can be toggled in settings.
  Focus Mode: The crosshair and player list (TAB) are automatically hidden while the wheel is open to let you focus on your items.
- Smooth Fade: No jarring pop-ups. The wheel appears with a professional alpha-fade and background blur effect.

## Visual Themes 🎨
Customize the look of your wheel via the in-game settings menu (Default key: Y):
- Animal Crossing Theme: Clean, minimalist floating circles for each item.
- GTA V Theme: A classic segmented ring with high-contrast selection paths.
- Custom Colors: Palette optimized with #e8e7d5 (Cream) for normal states and #ffde86 (Sunlight Yellow) for selected items.

## Full Customization ⚙️
Access the Radial Settings menu to tweak:
- Vanilla Hotbar Toggle: Choose if you want to keep the old hotbar visible or go full minimal.
- Wheel Scaling: Three size modes (Small, Medium, Large) or "Synced" to match your Minecraft GUI scale automatically.
- Sound Feedback: Satisfying UI "clicks" when navigating, with pitch variation based on the slot position.
![settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d5162fd45b31619177f4ff5418533d368541149_0.webp)

## Compatibility 🎮
**100% Client-Side:** Since it only changes your UI, you can use it on any vanilla or modded server without being banned or needing the mod installed on the server.
Shader Friendly: Works perfectly with Iris and Sodium.
